parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, presentation ban, facility exclusion, or border or custody rule is documented, and sexuality-law exposure is a dead letter. The anti-discrimination law lists gender identity in goods, services and health, and hate-crime enhancements exist. Against this, the record shows documented public hostility: a trans-presenting psychologist was subjected to threats and several physical attacks in 2023, and prosecutors often under-charge hate crimes, which weakens recourse. Pride history shows both organised opposition and police protection. Nothing in the dossier shows traveller-facing exposure, so the rating sits in the lower-middle elevated-to-reduced range. Trans-specific data is thin, and the 28.1% and 222-incident figures are single-year, not visitor-specific. Legal gender recognition rules are resident-facing and not deducted.
